component.name: Carbonate
component.summary: Serve Proton calendars and contacts to any CalDAV app

description.p: Proton Calendar and Proton Contacts are encrypted, which is the point of them and also why no ordinary calendar app can read them. Carbonate logs in to Proton, decrypts your calendars and contacts locally, and serves them on your own machine as CalDAV and CardDAV — the protocols every calendar app already speaks.

Point GNOME Calendar, Evolution, Thunderbird or anything else at it and your Proton calendar behaves like any other. Events you create or edit travel back to Proton, encrypted again before they leave.
Carbonate is not affiliated with Proton AG.

ul.li: Two-way sync: read your calendars, and write events back
Recurring events, exceptions to a series, and reminders
Guests are invited by mail, the way Proton does it
Nothing leaves your machine unencrypted, and nothing is sent anywhere but Proton
